items.summary: Migrate origin GitHub Pages → Cloudflare Pages; TTFB p75 1.3s is the field LCP bottleneck (FCP≈LCP).
items.why: GH Pages is a single-region origin; CF Pages serves static HTML from the edge. Single biggest LCP lever, free-tier.
items.recipe: wrangler pages project create + deploy git-tracked files; verify parity on preview URL (reuse check-staging-parity compare logic); attach custom domain / flip DNS via API; Worker security layer stays on zone routes.

items.summary: Worker edge-caches HTML with stale-while-revalidate + auto-purge on deploy.
items.why: S161 proved −81% LCP once. Warm-edge HTML for every visitor.
items.recipe: Worker: cache.put HTML responses with SWR semantics; deploy workflows call zone purge (studio token has scope).

items.summary: Enable 103 Early Hints: zone setting + Link preload headers for shell CSS/JS.
items.why: Browser fetches shell assets before HTML completes. Free, low risk.
items.recipe: PATCH zone setting early_hints=on; Worker adds Link: rel=preload headers for shell css/js.

items.summary: Split ambient into stable-core (rarely changes, stable hash) + volatile layer so deploys stop invalidating every visitor's cache.
items.why: Every ambient edit currently rotates the sitewide shell hash — the known cold-cache cost.
items.recipe: build-ambient-bundle emits two bundles split by git churn; propagate two script tags; SW precache + coherency gate updated.

items.summary: fetchpriority=high on hero LCP element + preload wordmark font subset + verify zero render-blocking.
items.why: Cheap polish that compounds with origin + cache wins.
items.recipe: Edit homepage hero, add preload links, rerun analyze-home-lcp.

items.summary: Self-hosted edge analytics in the Worker; remove gtag sitewide (founder-approved).
items.why: Kills a third-party origin on every page (DNS+connect+50KB), erases the last TT sink, removes GA CSP surface.
items.recipe: Worker /v/hit counter (KV daily aggregates, privacy-minimized, no cookies); tiny beacon in ambient; strip gtag inline from all pages via propagation; CSP cleanup; analytics rollup script + api/analytics-summary.json.

items.summary: Field-verdict regressed/anomaly canary → founder email via Resend.
items.why: Majors get paged; founder currently finds out next session.
items.recipe: scripts/send-regression-alert.mjs (resend.email capability) wired into rum-pull workflow after grading.

items.summary: Nightly synthetic traces from US/EU/Asia GH runners.
items.why: Catches geo-specific slowness majors catch with paid tooling.
items.recipe: .github/workflows/synthetic-geo.yml matrix; commits perf rows tagged by geo.

items.summary: Public /status/ from existing artifacts (CI beacon, site-health, field verdicts, staging parity).
items.why: Honest uptime surface; majors pay Statuspage for this.
items.recipe: Static page + renderer reading api/*.json; nav/footer/sitemap wiring.
